cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: Continuous contour edge connecting the superior orbital ridge to the nasal tip, exhibiting a shallow concave indentation at the nasal bridge transitioning into a linear downward slope at approximately 35 degrees relative to the mid-sagittal plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct dark-pigmented plumage patch localized on the posterior dorsal portion of the mane, contrasting with the primary tawny and reddish-brown pigmentation of the cranial mane.
